topic: The last-ball finish that gave a nation its very first World Cup
hook: One ball. One run. One nation's first World Cup.
script: One ball. One run. One nation's first World Cup. West Indies needed 6 off the last ball to win the 2016 T20 World Cup final. Carlos Brathwaite hit four consecutive sixes. Off the last four balls. Game over. West Indies won. England shattered. An entire nation erupted. Follow for cricket finishes that are impossible to describe in words.
